posts.text:
Let’s see if the russian musk bots are back online.

I just watched the Musk Movie. It was 4 hours long. (@alexgibneyfilm) TY for putting in an intermission.) There was so much information. Its genre is documentary, but it could easily be put under horror also. It was a very good movie, but also psychologically terrifying. 

I have to say the first hour of the movie, brought back memories of the old Elon. The one that my husband and I really liked. He was quirky, funny, smart, the first spacex successful launches were awesome, when Tesla was new, and everyone was excited about the electric cars, him working with Obama and him saying that AI was an existential risk. It was like he truly cared about the human race.

But then, he flips and turns into a villain. 😩 The last 3 hours he morphs into a psychotic megalomaniac. It was like an evil storm. The Tesla auto pilot starts crashing cars, killing people and then he lies about it & says how safe it is. He lost his shit during Covid with the lockdowns. His son transitioned into Vivian, and he said the woke mind virus needed to be destroyed. He went from AI being an existential threat & said it was summoning demons, to wanting to put an AI robot in every home. The government was regulating his businesses due to environmental concerns and he does not like being told what he can and cannot do.

I really believe part of the reason he went after our govt, to control it, was because of regulations they were putting on him and his companies. He realized to remove these regulations he needed to control politics. This is why our govt should not be able to be bought by the richest man in the world. The Ashley St. Clair part of the story is crazy! I’m glad she is exposing all these details. It was brave of her to tell her story. She could have easily signed the NDA and been rich, she decided to do the right thing. We need more people like this.

The doge part of the movie is devastating. Gutting really important humanitarian efforts, so many people, including children, around the world have died because of this. Halting scientific research projects, such as cancer research, that some have been working on for years. The purge of a lot of brightest and best from our govt departments, leaving dept frozen. Putting all our personal info in the hands of young kids who had idea what they were doing, who knows what will happen in the future now that all of info has been exposed. Cutting back at the EPA, surely helped his companies, but at what cost to our environment?

Watching the first quarter, he really could have been an amazing part of America’s history, but then he threw it all away and chose to be a villain. Why risk the future well being of America, especially when you have so many children? He says children are the future, yet the administration HE installed is dangerous and threatens our future. It makes no sense. 

It’s like he has lost all empathy for others. Maybe he’s high all the time, which means we have a drugged up psychopath, who doesn’t care about anything but his own personal endeavors, no matter the consequences, and that same person is in charge of our government. What could go wrong? We left the movie scared about the future of the whole world.

FSD V12 Introduced end-to-end neural-network driving.

FSD V13 built on that and reduced interventions.

FSD V14 brought point-to-point travel and a huge leap in capability, helping FSD start to go mainstream.

FSD V15 will bring:
• Pothole avoidance
• AI-based mapping and navigation rather than relying on conventional third-party maps.
• A new user interface that will re-render reality in a "mind-bending way."
• Fleet intelligence that incorporates driving information collected across Tesla vehicles.
• Voice integration, allowing drivers to request different routes conversationally (likely through Grok).
• Improved parking, destination handling and trip planning.
• 10x parameter count increase
• New lane change and exiting behavior
• And eventually (2027 for Model Y), FSD Unsupervised for personal cars (Tesla's robotaxis already run V15, and the personal Cybercabs being delivered next month likely will too).

Full release notes below

– – –  

v15 upgrades every part of the end-to-end driving network. Includes:

Upgraded vision encoder shared between FSD, Robotaxi, and Optimus, which is trained on millions of internet videos for improved generalization and data efficiency, improving the critical intervention rate by 25x.

Introduced Tesla Reality View, replacing all of the explicit model signals into a single end-to-end visualization using less total compute.

Improved navigation by using an end-to-end learned model based on route preference data from the fleet.

Improved parking location selection by using personalized parking history, and the map will now display multiple parking options at your destination.

Improved driver monitoring by increasing vision-based attention monitoring availability with hats and sunglasses and decreasing strictness in higher speed driver profiles.

Improved detection of road signs, small animals, road debris, and chains.

Improved detection of potholes, road details, and avoidance of deep standing water.

Improved speed handling for each driver profile, school zones and speed limits, and inclement weather.  

Improved Autoshift functionality by unifying with FSD-based gear predictions.

US home sellers are slashing prices at a record rate.

36% of homes sold in October had at least one price cut, the highest share in Redfin’s data, per Bloomberg. As buyers pull back, inventory has climbed to 1.59 million homes, the most for any October since 2019.

Prices are barely rising. The median home price rose just 0.4% from a year earlier to $416,700, the smallest annual gain since February. 

Earlier this year, Redfin found that sellers who cut their price were knocking off about 7%, or roughly $41,000, on average.
